fusions.name: Haymaker
fusions.desc: A heavy swipe that deals 18 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Avalanche Slam
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 40 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Unmoved Stance
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Cornered Fury
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
